fields.evidence: ecl::sound::PreloadSystem::FinalizeLoadRequests (EoCClient.dll+0xD947A0) gets the singleton (FUN_180d91b60) and indexes it with FUN_180d943e0 = ls::StaticArray<int,4>::Get (asserts index < 4, returns base + index*4) by the request's preload-list byte; adds +1 (load) or -1 (unload) and calls IPreloadLegacyHelper when a count crosses 0. List 2 is the ModuleLoadEvent list (assert text) and is incremented directly at +8. Live: [0, 0, 1, 0] - one module-load preload active.

open_questions: Names of preload lists 0, 1 and 3 (3 is used by PreloadSystem::ProcessCharacterCreationEvents; 2 = ModuleLoadEvent).
